params.name: inventoryItemGroupKey
params.description: This path parameter specifies the unique identifier of the inventory item group being retrieved. This value is assigned by the seller when an inventory item group is created.

items.docs: This call retrieves the inventory item group for a given inventoryItemGroupKey value. The inventoryItemGroupKey value is passed in at the end of the call URI.

params.name: inventoryItemGroupKey
params.description:
This path parameter specifies the unique identifier of the inventory item group being created or updated. This identifier is defined by the seller.

This value cannot be changed once it is set.

Max Length: 50

items.docs:
Note: Each listing can be revised up to 250 times in one calendar day. If this revision threshold is reached, the seller will be blocked from revising the item until the next calendar day.

params.name: inventoryItemGroupKey
params.description: This path parameter specifies the unique identifier of the inventory item group being deleted. This value is assigned by the seller when an inventory item group is created.

items.docs: This call deletes the inventory item group for a given inventoryItemGroupKey value.
